# **FG-05 \-- 027 \-- Make Payment**

1. # **Use-Case Name**

   UC-027 — Make Payment

   1. ## **Brief Description**

   A Customer uses an approved payment method for an owned order. Hza evidences the COD choice and unpaid-on-placement state; real online payment processing remains conditional on an approved integration.

   Functional group: FG-05 — Checkout & Payment

   Actor(s): Customer (C)

   Priority: Core

2. # **Flow of Events**

   1. ## **Basic Flow**

   1\. The Customer selects COD on the Hza checkout screen and reviews the payable amount.

   2\. The System validates the method and creates the owned order/payment record through UC-025/026.

   3\. The System displays COD with payment pending/unpaid; placing the order does not mark it paid.

   4\. The Customer pays upon receipt according to the store’s collection process.

   5\. Only an authorized trusted collection confirmation records the amount/time and changes payment to paid under the approved Backend contract.

   6\. The Customer retrieves the recorded result through UC-028.

   2. ## **Alternative Flows**

      1. ### *Input validation and business-rule alternatives*

   A1. If an approved online method is enabled, authorize the owned pending order, initiate its provider transaction, obtain the real provider result through a verified server-side mechanism and show confirmed or pending status. No such full UI/integration is supplied.

   A2. A simulated demo payment may be used only when explicitly labeled simulation; it must not be presented as real COD collection or a real gateway charge.

   A3. An order is missing/not owned, ineligible or has no payable pending payment: reject.

   A4. The latest payment is already paid: do not charge/process it again.

      2. ### *Additional outcomes and service failures*

   A5. Provider/collection evidence is invalid or the amount/currency does not match: reject the state change.

   A6. A timeout or interrupted return leaves payment pending/unknown; query authoritative status rather than claim failure or success.

   A7. A session expires or permissions fail: deny access. A supported failed online payment may continue through UC-029 only after failure is confirmed.

3. # **Special Requirements**

   1. ## **Use-case quality and integrity constraints**

   • Source conflict: the old document simulates unconditional success after validation, decreases actual and reserved stock and leaves order PENDING. Hza shows COD unpaid after order creation. These are different workflows and must not be silently combined.

   • COD and MOMO enum names in the old notes do not prove complete method-specific integrations, webhooks or decline handling.

   • Trusted payment/collection evidence, ownership checks, idempotent settlement and distinct order/payment states are required.

   • Stock finalization for COD versus online/simulated payment requires an approved lifecycle; do not deduct stock twice.

4. # **Preconditions**

   1. ## **Conditions that must hold**

   • An eligible owned order and pending payment exist; the selected method is enabled.

   • Real collection/provider confirmation is required for a real paid result.

5. # **Postconditions**

   1. ## **Success and failure states**

   Success:

   • Only a trusted confirmed collection/provider result can mark a real payment paid; COD placement alone stays unpaid.

   Failure:

   • No unverified paid state, duplicate settlement or unauthorized order disclosure occurs.

6. # **Extension Points**

   1. ## **Related use cases and scope**

   No named UML extension location is verified in the supplied model tab. Related use cases: UC-025 Checkout; UC-026 Place Order; UC-028 View Payment Status; UC-029 Retry Failed Payment.

   Scope: Basic flow follows Hza COD semantics. Collection UI and real online payment screens are absent. The older simulated-success flow is retained as an explicit conflicting demo contract, not asserted as live behavior.

   Sources: Vision v1.4; shared PA3 Use-Case Model; Hza.zip static exports; earlier Thành specifications dated 11 November 2026\. Prior Backend statements have not been revalidated against repository code in this revision.

   Performed by: Trịnh Văn Thành \| Reviewed by: Pending \| Status: Draft for review
